045de390d3.q: Why did Jerry Katz's family leave Russia in 1974 and what route did they take to the United States?
045de390d3.a: Katz's family left Russia in 1974 as part of the first waves of Jewish immigration because his father, a mechanical engineer, could not advance under communism without being a Communist Party member, and having 'Jew' on his passport prevented career progression. They traveled via train with Israeli army escort during 'Black October,' when the Soviets were bombing Jewish trains leaving the country, and eventually traveled through Austria and Italy, where the Vatican assisted Jewish refugees. They ended up in Brooklyn, New York.
